text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} is helping make
picture books at Misato's behest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はミサトに頼まれ、
絵本作りを手伝っていた。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
What sort of story would be best?
Something adventure related, maybe?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
どんなお話にしようかしら～
やっぱり冒険のお話とか……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh! {0}!
You've gotten all shiny again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
あらあらあら！
{0}君ったら、
また光ってるわよ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That never stops being amazing.
How in the world do you do it—
text_block_list.orig_text:
凄いわ～
それどうやってやってるのかしら――

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone!
Line yourselves up for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい、
みんなちゃんと一列になってねー

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Okay!
text_block_list.orig_text: はーい！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The expedition isn't over until we get back home.
Hm? Well, if it isn't {0}. Good day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、
保育園に帰るまでがお散歩ですからねー
……あら？　{0}君じゃない。
こんにちは～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence.
Are you on a stroll as well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
偶然ね～
あなたもお散歩～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
We're all going to make picture books after this.
Would you be interested in joining?
choice_data_list: I'm not that good at drawing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はこのあとみんなで絵本作りをするんだけど、
よかったらあなたもどうかしら？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Well then! Let's be on our way.
The more the merrier, as they say. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら！　
じゃあ行きましょー
人数は多い方が楽しいもの♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
There's no right or wrong when it comes to picture books.
If anything, one drawn by you should feel very unique. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら大丈夫よ。
絵本に正解も不正解もないんだから。
あなたの絵で世界に一つの絵本を作りましょう♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
Let's jot down some ideas and drawings on this piece of paper.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあさあ、
この紙にみんなで考えたお話と
絵を描いていきましょうね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: What sort of story do you all want to read?
text_block_list.orig_text: みんなはどんなお話がいいかな～？

text_block_list.name: Girl 1
text_block_list.text: One about a prince and a princess!
text_block_list.orig_text: 王子様とお姫様のはなしー！

text_block_list.name: Girl 2
text_block_list.text: Me too, me too! And the prince has to be super handsome, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私もー！　
それでねー、
王子様はちょうイケメンにする！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. What else about him stands out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
他にはどんな特徴があるの？

text_block_list.name: Girl 1
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
He's rich, right? And super fashionable?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んーとねー、
お金持ちでしょー、
おしゃれでしょー

text_block_list.name: Girl 2
text_block_list.text:
And tall, too!
Plus he'll buy anything he's asked for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
背も高いのがいいなー！　
あとなんでも買ってくれる人！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
My, my. I appreciate everyone's input,
but it's worth saying that a person's appearance and
stature doesn't determine their worth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
みんな、
見た目や肩書きだけじゃ、
その人の価値は決まらないものなのよー

text_block_list.name: Girl 2
text_block_list.text: What sort of person do you like, then?
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあ美里先生はどんな人が好きなのー？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hm. Let's see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
そうねぇ……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Someone who's pure and honest, plus cares for other people?
text_block_list.orig_text:
純粋でまっすぐで、
思いやりがある人かしら。

text_block_list.name: Girl 1
text_block_list.text: That's too complicated!
text_block_list.orig_text: よくわかんなーい！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You'll understand soon enough.
Especially when you come to know someone just like that. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、
みんなにもいつかわかる日がくるわよ。
そういう人が自分の近くに現れたら……
ね♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That's enough about me, though.
Let's focus on making a story you want to hear.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
先生のことより、
みんなの作りたい絵本のお話しをしましょうね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: And there we have it. Welcome back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れ様。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing surprising about a girl
having their ideal of a special prince.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子様、
女の子だったら誰だって憧れちゃうわよね～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
It can differ wildly between people, of course,
but Misato's take on the matter shows how mature she is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人それぞれ理想の王子様像はあるんだろうけど、
ちゃんと人の中身を見ようとするミサト先生って大人だと思うわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
All the superficial stuff doesn't matter to her.
She's much more interested in a kind, caring prince.
text_block_list.orig_text:
張りぼての王子様なんかより、
心が温かい人の方が、
彼女にとっては王子様なのかもね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That's enough for today, though.
Catch you later. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はこの辺にしとくわ。
じゃーねー♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... 
H-huh? When did I fall asleep...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……
あ、
あらぁ？　
先生ってばいつの間にか眠っちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Looks like I wasn't the only sleepyhead.
That's twice now that we've fallen asleep together. Hehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
あなたも眠っていたのねぇ。
また二人そろって寝ちゃうなんてねぇ。
うふふふ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I had quite the peculiar dream, too.
We were all making picture books together—
text_block_list.orig_text:
とても不思議な夢だったのよ。
夢の中でも絵本を作ってて……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You had the same dream as well?
That happened last time, too, didn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
同じ夢を見ていたの？
前もそうだったわよね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: What's that? You want to know who my ideal prince is?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
先生の理想の王子様は誰かって……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Well... That's a good question.
Maybe I'll get to meet him soon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうねぇ……
誰かしらね～
どこかにいないかしら～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Very soon, even. Hehe. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
チラリ……
うふふ♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I have an idea!
How about we make a story based on the
ideal prince I talked about in that dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだわぁ！　
夢の中で先生が言った
「純粋でまっすぐで、
人への思いやりがある王子様」のお話を作るのはどう？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have much trouble making one like that. ♪
I mean...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら先生、
とっても上手に描けると思うの♪
だってね……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I happen to know someone precisely like that. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
すぐ近くに
そういう人がいるんですもの♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus the two of them got to work,
Misato oddly giddy the entire time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜか上機嫌のミサトと一緒に、
仲良く絵本を作る{0}であった。
